# Positive Health Online

> A comprehensive UK-based wellness platform offering health articles, practitioner directories, courses, events, and natural products spanning complementary medicine, alternative therapies, and holistic health.

Positive Health Online is a leading resource for complementary and alternative medicine in the UK and Ireland, featuring expert articles, research, practitioner networks, and a wellness marketplace. The site serves as both a publishing platform for health education and a directory connecting users with qualified therapists, courses, and wellness products.

## Key Topics

- Alternative Medicine
- Complementary Therapy
- Holistic Health
- Homeopathy
- Craniosacral Therapy
- Alexander Technique
- Bowen Technique
- Ayurveda
- Therapist Directory
- Wellness Marketplace
- Health Research
- Medical Conditions
- Natural Supplements
- UK Wellness Events
- Health Articles

## Core Directories & Marketplaces

- [Therapists Directory](https://www.positivehealth.com/therapists): Directory of complementary medicine practitioners and therapists
- [Courses](https://www.positivehealth.com/courses): Directory of alternative medicine and holistic therapy courses
- [Events](https://www.positivehealth.com/events): Directory of wellness events, workshops and courses in UK
- [Products and Services](https://www.positivehealth.com/products): Marketplace for health supplements and natural wellness products
- [Classified Ads](https://www.positivehealth.com/pyads): Classified ads platform for health services and wellness marketplace
- [Resource Links](https://www.positivehealth.com/links): Resource directory linking to complementary health and therapy sites

## Articles, Research & Education

- [Articles Index](https://www.positivehealth.com/articles): Index of complementary and alternative health articles by topic
- [Research](https://www.positivehealth.com/researches): Index of health research on alternative medicine and wellness therapies
- [Book Reviews](https://www.positivehealth.com/reviews): Directory of book reviews on alternative medicine and wellness topics
- [The Great Menopausal Brain Reset](https://www.positivehealth.com/article/nutrition/the-great-menopausal-brain-reset-what-you-need-to-know): Article on menopause, hormones and cognitive health by Penny Crowther
- [Improvements in Healthcare](https://www.positivehealth.com/article/authority-rights-freedom/improvements-in-healthcare-the-impact-on-the-population): Article on healthcare advances and pharmaceutical safety by Patrick Quanten
- [Clearing Clutter – Tidying Up Your Life](https://www.positivehealth.com/article/nlp/clearing-clutter-tidying-up-your-life-group-coaching): Article on decluttering and wellness coaching by Frances Coombes
